title: Analytics Manager, Product
jobDescription:
🚀 Why Headout?

We’re a rocketship: 9-figure revenue, record growth, and profitable

With $200M+ in revenue, guests in 700+ cities, and 18 months of profitability, Headout is the fastest-growing marketplace in the travel industry, and we’re just getting started. We've raised $60M+ from top-tier investors and are building a durable company for the long term — because that's what our mission needs and deserves. We’re growing, profitable and nowhere near done.

What we do is important

In an increasingly digital world, there is a desperate need to augment our human experience by getting us to interact with the real world around us and the people in it. At Headout, our mission is to be the easiest, fastest, and most delightful way to head out to a real-life experience — from immersive tours to museums to live events and everything in between.

Why now?

The foundation is strong. The opportunity ahead is even bigger. We’ve hit profitability, built momentum, and proven the model — but there’s so much more to build. If you’re looking to join a company where the trajectory is steep and your impact is real, this is the moment.

Our culture

Reinventing the travel industry isn't easy, but that's the fun part.
We care deeply about ownership, craft, and impact, and we’re here to do the best work of our careers. We won’t pretend like it’s for everyone but if you’re a builder who loves solving tough problems, you’ll feel right at home.

👩‍💻 The role

As Manager, Product Analytics, you'll lead the analytics function for Headout's Product org. This isn't about dashboards and reports; it's about building product intelligence that compounds into competitive advantage.

You'll define the metrics that matter, build the experimentation muscle, and ensure product decisions are grounded in customer understanding. You'll partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to shape what we build, not just measure what we shipped.

You'll also build and lead a team of product analysts who operate like owners: sharp on metrics, strong on problem framing, and measured by the outcomes they enable, not the analyses they deliver.

🤩 What makes this role special?

  • Build Product Intelligence, Not Just Measurement: You'll define the metrics, frameworks, and experimentation systems that make Headout's product smarter over time. Your work shapes the intelligence layer, not just the reporting layer.
  • Thought Partner, Not Report Generator: You'll work directly with Product leadership to answer "what should we build next?" not just "what happened?" You'll bring clarity on customer behaviour, funnel bottlenecks, and where the highest-leverage opportunities are. When the product roadmap is debated, your perspective will be in the room.
  • Shape the Experimentation Engine: You'll raise the bar on how we run experiments; hypothesis quality, statistical rigor, guardrails, and decision-making. You'll help teams move fast without making noisy or misleading calls. Experimentation becomes a capability, not a bottleneck.
  • Build a Team of Owners: You'll hire, mentor, and develop product analysts who own problem domains, not task queues. Analysts who can frame problems, define success, and drive adoption, not just write SQL and hand off slides.
  • Drive Outcomes That Compound: Your work will directly improve conversion, retention, and LTV. But more importantly, it will build systems that keep improving: ranking models that learn, retention frameworks that clarify priorities, recommendations that get smarter. The advantage compounds.

💝 What skills & experience do you need?

  • 6-10 years in product analytics, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring analysts. Track record of defining metrics that teams actually use to make decisions.
  • Strong problem framing: you can translate ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses and clear measurement plans.
  • Experimentation expertise: you've run A/B tests end-to-end, understand statistical pitfalls, and know when experiments are needed and when they're not
  • Full-funnel fluency: acquisition → activation → conversion → retention. You can diagnose drop-offs, interpret cohort behaviour, and identify segmentation insights
  • Advanced SQL; comfortable with Python/R for analysis and statistics

You'll set the strategic direction for growth, translate it into a focused roadmap, and execute with speed and rigour. You'll sit at the crossroads of product strategy, experimentation culture, and cross-functional leadership, and you'll leave fingerprints on every meaningful metric across the funnel.

We're building toward 2x in two years and 5x in five. This role is how we get there.

🤩 What Makes This Role Special

  • Shape the Growth Strategy: Define the multi-horizon roadmap for growth - balancing near-term wins with foundational systems.
  • Drive Outsized Impact: Your decisions will influence millions of users and tens of millions in GMV.
  • Build a Culture of Experimentation: Institutionalise hypothesis-driven thinking across the team and the organisation.
  • Partner at the Leadership Table: Work directly with the Product, Design, Engineering leadership, and senior stakeholders to align priorities and resources.
  • Lead a Growth & Customer Experience Squad: Own and grow a team of PMs working across.

🌟 What You’ll Bring

  • Deep understanding of your target user and the ability to translate insights into high-impact features.
  • Strong product sense—you know what great looks like, and how to get there.
  • Ability to break down complex problems, make trade-offs, and prioritize based on user and business impact.
  • Clear, structured communicator - whether it’s writing PRDs or aligning stakeholders.
  • Comfortable coaching product managers and creating alignment across pods and functions.

🧠 What you will work on

  • Own the user conversion and post-booking experience charter end-to-end across web and app.
  • Define a coherent growth strategy that ladders up to company-level goals and communicates clearly to leadership.
  • Lead a small team of PMs - setting direction, coaching on craft, removing blockers, and creating conditions for high performance.
  • Build a rigorous experimentation programme: prioritisation frameworks, test velocity targets, and a culture of learning from failure.
  • Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing on growth priorities and resource allocation.
  • Identify compounding growth levers - flywheel effects, platform bets, and structural improvements alongside tactical wins.
  • Define and hold the team accountable to OKRs, experiment velocity, and impact metrics across the funnel.
  • Represent the growth & customer experience charter in cross-functional planning cycles, including annual and quarterly roadmap reviews.

💝 What Skills & Experience You Need

  • Demonstrated track record of owning growth outcomes - discovery, conversion, retention.

  • Excellent analytical skills: comfortable with funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and using data to both identify opportunities and measure impact.

  • Strong written and verbal communication - able to craft clear strategy docs, PRDs, and leadership narratives.

Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.

🤩 What makes this role special?

  • Real problems, not busywork: Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
  • Breadth of exposure: You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
  • Learn fast by doing: You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
  • A team that gives a damn: We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
  • A product you can care about: Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.

💝 What skills & experience do you need?

  • 1 - 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
  • Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.
  • Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis
  • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airflow, or similar; basic understanding of data warehousing concepts
  • Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e-commerce, consumer tech

  • Deep Domain Expertise: You have hands-on experience untangling the complexities of digital marketing and business analytics. You're comfortable dissecting performance marketing channels (Paid Search, SEO, Affiliates, CRM) and modeling business drivers like LTV and CAC.
  • Technical Proficiency: Your technical toolkit is sharp. You possess advanced proficiency in SQL for complex analysis and are comfortable with a scripting language like Python or R for statistical modeling. Experience with modern BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) and data warehousing concepts is essential.
  • A Pragmatic and Strategic Mindset: You are an analytical, creative thinker who can navigate ambiguity. You have a bias for action and know how to make the right trade-offs between speed, depth, and accuracy to deliver maximum impact.

👨‍💻 The Role

As a Staff Engineer at Headout, you will drive architectural excellence and technical strategy across multiple product engineering pods. You'll solve some of our most complex, high-impact engineering challenges: designing very low-latency systems that power dynamic pricing strategies, processing large-scale inventory data across tens of thousands of products, and managing vendor ecosystem coordination spanning almost half a million vendors growing everyday. Beyond building systems, you'll be a force multiplier for technical excellence, partnering with Engineering Managers to eliminate technical debt, improve deployment stability, and build resilient system boundaries that allow our teams and business to scale sustainably. Your work will shape how we architect systems for the next phase of growth.

🤩 What Makes This Role Special?

  • Large-Scale System Design: Design very low-latency systems solving critical business challenges: dynamic pricing strategies, large-scale inventory data processing across tens of thousands of products, and vendor ecosystem management spanning almost half a million vendors. See your architecture impact millions of travelers in real-time.
  • Strategic Technical Debt Reduction: Lead systematic reduction of technical debt across pods, reshaping system architecture to improve deployment stability, reduce operational complexity, and enable teams to scale with confidence. This is career-defining work that prevents future chaos.
  • Architectural Ownership Across Boundaries: Own architectural decisions that span multiple pods and teams. Guide the design of resilient, high-availability systems without needing direct authority—influence through technical excellence and clear thinking.
  • Technical Excellence Meets Business Impact: Partner closely with Engineering Managers to balance technical excellence with delivery velocity. Influence critical decisions on architecture trade-offs, ensuring we build for both today's needs and tomorrow's scale.
  • Design Leadership & Mentorship: Elevate engineering standards across your pod ecosystem through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. Shape how systems are built and help other engineers grow as technical thinkers.
  • Profitable, Sustainable Growth: Work on systems directly powering millions of travelers worldwide in a profitable, bootstrapped company. Your architectural decisions have immediate business impact—no endless VC burn, real product-market fit.
  • Modern Distributed Systems Stack: Build with cutting-edge technologies solving real distributed systems challenges: Kafka for event-driven architectures, Kotlin and Spring Boot for backend excellence, PostgreSQL and MongoDB for complex data models, and AWS for cloud-native infrastructure.

💝 What Skills & Experience Do You Need?

  • 7+ years of software development experience with at least 5+ years in backend systems and distributed architectures. Prior experience mentoring engineers and driving technical initiatives across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
  • Deep expertise in backend technologies: Spring Boot, Kotlin, and Java. Strong foundation in distributed systems concepts (eventual consistency, scalability, fault tolerance, high availability, CAP theorem trade-offs) with proven ability to design systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with modern distributed tech stack: Kafka or similar event-driven architectures, relational databases (PostgreSQL, MariaDB), NoSQL systems (MongoDB), Redis for caching, and AWS cloud infrastructure. Able to make informed architectural trade-offs across the full stack.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. Strong commitment to code quality, testing practices, and engineering standards. Drive adoption of best practices and raise the bar for how systems are built.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Can articulate trade-offs, justify decisions, and make technical strategy accessible.
  • Collaborative mindset with high agency and ownership mentality. Comfortable working across team boundaries, influencing without direct authority, and taking initiative on technical challenges.
  • Growth mindset, grit, and resilience in fast-paced environments. Excited about continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies. Able to navigate ambiguity, handle complex stakeholder situations, and maintain focus on long-term technical vision.
